name: 32064 · Live Oak, FL
findings: ZIP 32064 (Live Oak) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32064 (Live Oak) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32064 (Live Oak) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
